Kamva 1.2.0 adds every Steam artwork size, so you can make store and library graphics without looking up the requirements.

## Download (Windows 10/11, 64-bit)

- **Kamva-Setup-1.2.0.exe**: installer with Start menu and desktop shortcuts; opens `.kamva` files
- **Kamva-1.2.0-portable.exe**: single file, no install needed
- macOS (Apple silicon, .zip) and Linux (.AppImage) builds are attached when those builds succeed

The builds aren't code-signed. If SmartScreen shows "Windows protected your PC", choose **More info → Run anyway**.

## New: Steam sizes

**New design → Steam** (or search "steam") lists every Steamworks graphical asset at its exact size, with a note on what each one should contain:

| Asset | Size | Notes |
|---|---|---|
| Header capsule | 920 × 430 | Logo + artwork |
| Small capsule | 462 × 174 | Logo + artwork; keep the logo big |
| Main capsule | 1232 × 706 | Logo + artwork |
| Vertical capsule | 748 × 896 | Logo + artwork |
| Screenshot | 1920 × 1080 | 16:9, gameplay |
| Page background | 1438 × 810 | Subtle, not too bright (optional) |
| Library capsule | 600 × 900 | Logo + artwork |
| Library header | 920 × 430 | Logo + artwork |
| Library hero | 3840 × 1240 | Artwork only, no logo; PNG |
| Library logo | 1280 × 720 | Logo only; transparent PNG |
| Event cover | 800 × 450 | Artwork + copy |
| Event header | 1920 × 622 | Artwork + logo (optional) |
| Shortcut icon | 256 × 256 | PNG or ICO |
| App icon | 184 × 184 | JPG |

## New: Steam templates

A matching starter template for each of these, in one shared style so the set reads as a kit. Find them under **Templates → Steam**. Drop your key art onto the page background to replace the illustration, and change the logo text.

For the library logo, export as **PNG** with **Transparent background** on.
